text:
mike: Quick heads-up — I opened a change to the event contract for token-cost attribution. PR https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/912 : adds `tokens`, `token_breakdown`, and `billing_customer_id` to the ingestion event.

ravi: taking a look. main thing: how are we determining `billing_customer_id` for anonymous traffic? need clear join key.

mike: plan is `billing_customer_id = user.id || anon_id_map.lookup(anon_id)` — fallback to anon mapping. I added a note in the PR about edge cases.

kayla: heads-up: consumer (ingest-consumer) will drop unknown top-level keys unless we bump the parser version. That means new fields won't show up in downstream raw tables without a short migration.

sre-bot: @channel Deploy guidance: do canary rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitors: `token-ingest-latency`, `token-cost-aggregation`, `consumer-error-rate`. Auto-rollback if latency > 300ms or error-rate > 1%.

jen: I can own the canary run and dashboards. Assigning schema mapping to @kayla and PR review to @ravi.

ravi: quick note — tests failing locally: `ingest/tests/test_payload_merge.py` because `anon_id` normalization changed. I will push a small fix to the branch after CI completes on my fork.

mike: thanks. Also added a sample daily agg CSV in the PR description for billing to sanity-check their joins. Billing asked for one row per `billing_customer_id` with `token_total` and `avg_latency_ms`.

telemetry-bot: alert created: `token-cost-delta` > 10% (24h window).

kayla: proposed short-term fix: compatibility shim in consumer — if `tokens` not present, run existing estimator `estimateTokens(text)` and populate `tokens`. I'll open a consumer PR (ingest-consumer#478) and tag for review. ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PST.

jen: docs? we need a short migration note and a changelog entry for the model owners. mike: I'll add a 2-paragraph note in docs repo and link to both PRs.

mike: blockers: 1) need final sign-off from billing on sample agg format, 2) need consumer PR merged (kayla), 3) ravi to unblock test. If all green we start canary tomorrow afternoon.

ravi: will finish review + test fix by EOD. ping me directly if you need me to drop everything.

kayla: will open mapping PR in ~1 hour. tagging @sre for any infra needs during canary.

sre-bot: scheduled maintenance window check: none conflicting tomorrow 15:00-17:00 PST.

mike: perfect — summary checklist added to PR. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
